description: Express.js route definitions for development endpoints, including database status, seeding data, index verification, and in-memory model fallback.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: A Mongoose model or in-memory stub for sample data, created dynamically if the real model is unavailable.

methods.name: Sample.countDocuments
methods.description: Counts documents in the sample collection or in-memory array.

methods.name: Sample.insertMany
methods.description: Inserts multiple documents into the sample collection or in-memory array.

methods.name: Sample.findOne
methods.description: Finds the most recent sample document or returns null.

methods.name: Sample.find
methods.description: Finds up to three sample documents.
